title: Firmware bring-up on the emulator before touching hardware

steps.action: Map the image and entry point in an emulated context; run to the first halt and record the state before any hardware flash
Use checkpoint-patch-run-rollback to probe peripheral assumptions instead of bricking hardware
Time-travel to the faulting event and diff the state against the last known-good checkpoint
Only after the emulator loop is green, replay the same sequence on the live target with recording enabled

decision_hooks.criteria: The dispatched task brings up or debugs firmware on an embedded or microcontroller target
